params.name: id
params.description: A channel id to filter the results by.

params.name: include
params.description: Associated resources to include in the response. Accepts `environment_settings` to include per-environment channel configuration.

params.name: after
params.description: The cursor to fetch entries after.

params.name: before
params.description: The cursor to fetch entries before.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of entries to fetch per-page.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of channels. Note: the list of channels is across the entire account, not scoped to an environment.

params.name: channel_key
params.description: The key of the channel to retrieve.

items.docs: Returns a channel with all environment-specific settings. Secret values in provider settings are obfuscated unless they are Liquid templates (e.g., `{{ vars.api_key }}`).
